preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and queries m are within the range [1, 200000].

preconditions.expression: len(initial_values) == n and all(1 <= v <= 1000 for v in initial_values)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n initial values, each between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 edges connecting nodes within the valid range [1, n], forming a tree rooted at 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and (1 <= val <= 1000 if q_type == 1 else True) for q_type, x, val in queries)
preconditions.description: All queries reference valid nodes x, and type 1 queries have valid val in [1, 1000].

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == len([q for q in queries if q[0] == 2])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 queries.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(initial_values[node_idx] + sum((val * ((-1)**(depth[node] - depth[x]))) for (q_type, x, val) in queries if q_type == 1 and depth[node] >= depth[x] and is_ancestor(x, node))) for i, (q_type, node, _) in enumerate(queries) if q_type == 2)
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query on node 'node', the output is the initial value of 'node' plus the sum of propagated values from all prior type 1 updates. An update 'val' on node 'x' contributes 'val * (-1)^(depth[node] - depth[x])' to 'node' if 'x' is an ancestor of 'node' (including itself), and 0 otherwise.
